name: Busa Email
description: The review desk: triage queue, editable drafts, and approve / request-changes / block decisions.

agentPrompts.label: Triage my inbox
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-email` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then propose a bounded batch plan for the accounts and scope I describe and wait for my explicit approval before scanning any live mail.

agentPrompts.label: What's still waiting on my review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-email` skill in this folder, then open the review desk and summarize the items still in Needs Review, newest first, with a short reason for each.

agentPrompts.label: Execute my approved decisions
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-email` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then execute only the decisions that are already materialized and explicitly approved in the review desk — never a decision still sitting in an unmerged change request — and report what was executed, blocked, or failed.
